## Monitors

Monitors show data from **Logic Video Connections**. This can be either from a [camera](https://stormworks.fandom.com/wiki/Wiki/Building/Components/Video/Cameras), or a [Lua script](https://stormworks.fandom.com/wiki/Wiki/Game_Mechanics/Lua). Monitors can be mirrored, which also mirrors the video signal!

[![Video Connection](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/stormworks_gamepedia_en/images/b/b3/Video_Connection.jpg/revision/latest/scale-to-width-down/180?cb=20200129200527)](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/stormworks_gamepedia_en/images/b/b3/Video_Connection.jpg/revision/latest?cb=20200129200527)

[https://stormworks.fandom.com/wiki/File:Video_Connection.jpg](https://stormworks.fandom.com/wiki/File:Video_Connection.jpg)
